Bumps the transitive dependency `event-listener` from `5.4.1` to `5.4.2` in `Cargo.lock`. Lockfile-only — no manifest or source changes.

The PR-time `audit` job (`cargo audit --deny warnings`) currently fails on **every** open pull request:

```
error: 1 denied warning found!
Crate:    event-listener
Version:  5.4.1
Warning:  unsound
Title:    `event-listener` allows `!Send` tags to cross thread boundaries via `StackSlot`
ID:       RUSTSEC-2026-0221
```

The daily `scheduled-audit` job stayed green throughout because the two jobs use different tools with different severity semantics (an intentional split, per `CLAUDE.md`):

| Job | Tool | Behaviour on an `unsound` advisory |
|---|---|---|
| `audit` (PR / push) | `cargo audit --deny warnings` | **fails the run** |
| `scheduled-audit` (daily) | `rustsec/audit-check@v2` | files an issue, **exits 0** |

`event-listener 5.4.2` is the patched release — the advisory declares `patched = [">= 5.4.2"]`. It reaches the graph transitively via `sqlx-core 0.9.0` and `async-lock 3.4.2` / `redis 1.4.1`, so no manifest pin is involved. The bump also drops `concurrent-queue`, which 5.4.2 no longer needs.

Verified locally: `cargo audit --deny warnings` exits 0 after the bump.

Unblocks the `audit` gate on the open Dependabot PRs (#158, #162, #163, #165) and on any future PR.

Closes #161
